title: Onyinye nke Gbanwere Akara Aka
intro: N'oge mbụ nke mmadụ, mkpụrụ obi na-enye onyinye nwere ezi ebumnuche. Ma, anyaụfụ zoro n'onyinyo nke nnabata. Chọpụta akụkọ nke onye a nke nsọpụrụ Chineke na njedebe ya dị egwu na-adịgide adịgide n'ime mkpughe Chineke.
clues: Eso m n'ọgbọ mbụ nke ụmụ mmadụ.
Enyere m Onyenwe m onyinye, a nabatakwara m ya nke ọma.
A jụrụ onyinye nwanne m nwoke, anyaụfụ gbakwara obi ya.
Agwara m ya, sị, 'Ọ bụrụ na ị gbatịa aka gị n'ebe m nọ ka ị gbuo m, agaghị m agbatị aka m igbu gị; n'ezie ana m atụ egwu Allah, Onyenwe ụwa.'
Abụrụ m onye e gburu n'oge mbụ e gburu mmadụ n'ụwa.
Ọbara m tiri mkpu, abụkwa m onye mbụ nwụrụ n'ihi ihe ọjọọ.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Habil (Ebel)
Qabil (Ken)
Nwoke si Ya-Sin
Ndị Samiri
Luqman

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: A nabatara onyinye ya, nke mere ka nwanne ya nwoke nwee anyaụfụ na igbu ọchụ ya.
A tụbara ya n'ime ọkụ na-ere ọkụ mana ọ pụtara n'enweghị ihe mere ya
Ọ rụrụ nnukwu ụgbọ mmiri n'okpuru nduzi Chineke
Azụ̀ ukwu loro ya, ọ nọkwa n'ọchịchịrị.
O duuru ndị ya gafee oké osimiri nke kewara ekewa
trial.answer: A nabatara onyinye ya, nke mere ka nwanne ya nwoke nwee anyaụfụ na igbu ọchụ ya.

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Onyinye a nabatara
Mkpanaka na-aghọ agwọ
Nne kamel dị ka ihe ịrịba ama Chineke
Onye na-egwu hoopoe na-eweta ozi
E ji ọlaedo fee nwa ehi a na-efe ofufe

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Ogbugbu mbụ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme; a mara nwanne ya nwoke ikpe
Ala loro ya na akụ ya
Agbanweela ya ka ọ bụrụ enwe n'ihi mmebi iwu
Ifufe dị ike nke ice bibiri ya
E gbubiri ya n'ime oke idei mmiri dị ka ntaramahụhụ
outcome.answer: Ogbugbu mbụ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme; a mara nwanne ya nwoke ikpe

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
